info.name: Assessly API
info.description: Production API Collection for the Assessly Higher Education Examination & Assessment Platform. Covers Auth, Password Recovery, Departments, Question Banks, Timed Exams, Entitlements, Offline Payments (Telebirr/CBE), Study Materials, and Admin Analytics.

item.name: Register Student
item.description: Registers student, hashes password, enrolls in department, and initializes 5-question Free Trial ledger.

item.name: Login Student
item.description: Authenticates student and stores authToken.

item.name: Login Super Admin
item.description: Authenticates default administrator and automatically stores adminToken.

item.name: Forgot Password
item.description: Requests a password reset link sent to registered email via live SMTP with SHA-256 token hashing.

item.name: Reset Password
item.description: Submits new password along with the unhashed reset token received via email.

item.name: Change Password
item.description: Authenticated user changes password by verifying current credentials.
